items.text: The research suggests a strong correlation between sleep quality and academic performance.
items.translationCn: 该研究表明睡眠质量与学业表现之间存在很强的相关性。
items.ipa: /ðə rɪˈsɜːtʃ səˈdʒests ə strɒŋ ˌkɒrəˈleɪʃn bɪˈtwiːn sliːp ˈkwɒləti ənd ˌækəˈdemɪk pəˈfɔːməns/

items.text: Before drawing any conclusion, we need to examine whether the sample was truly representative.
items.translationCn: 在得出任何结论之前，我们需要检查样本是否真正具有代表性。
items.ipa: /bɪˈfɔː ˈdrɔːɪŋ ˈeni kənˈkluːʒn wi niːd tu ɪɡˈzæmɪn ˈweðə ðə ˈsɑːmpl wɒz ˈtruːli ˌreprɪˈzentətɪv/

items.text: Collaboration across departments often produces insights that no single team could reach alone.
items.translationCn: 跨部门协作常常产生任何单个团队都无法独立获得的洞见。
items.ipa: /kəˌlæbəˈreɪʃn əˈkrɒs dɪˈpɑːtmənts ˈɒfn ˈprɒdjuːsɪz ˈɪnsaɪts ðət nəʊ ˈsɪŋɡl tiːm kʊd riːtʃ əˈləʊn/

items.text: I would argue that the benefits of the policy outweigh its short term costs for most students.
items.translationCn: 我认为对大多数学生而言，这项政策的收益超过其短期成本。
items.ipa: /aɪ wʊd ˈɑːɡjuː ðət ðə ˈbenɪfɪts əv ðə ˈpɒləsi ˌaʊtˈweɪ ɪts ʃɔːt tɜːm kɒsts fə məʊst ˈstjuːdnts/
